# obix-driver-storage-persistence

> Previous name: `@obinexusltd/obix-driver-storage-persistence` — OBIX packages are named without an npm scope since decision D-102 (2026-09-29); the package, its version and its exports are unchanged.

OBIX Storage Persistence Driver - LocalStorage/IndexedDB wrapper for state caching

Part of the OBIX monorepo (driver/obix-driver-storage-persistence). See docs/recovery/ at the repository root for provenance and status.

## Installation

```bash
npm install obix-driver-storage-persistence
```

> **Not yet on npm.** The OBIX packages are prepared for publication and are published only on the owner's authorisation; until then this is the command the published package will answer to.

## Basic usage

```js
import { createStoragePersistenceDriver } from 'obix-driver-storage-persistence';
```

## API surface

- `obix-driver-storage-persistence` — 1 value export: `createStoragePersistenceDriver`
- Type declarations: `./dist/index.d.ts` (and a declaration next to every JS entry point).

## Architecture role

`obix-driver-storage-persistence` is a **driver**: it performs one platform effect for OBIX components (the DOM driver `obix-driver-dom` is the one applications use directly, to mount components).

The architecture of OBIX — the package families and which packages are public API — is indexed in the umbrella: [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/obinexus/obix/blob/main/docs/architecture.md).

## Package relationships

- Depends on (OBIX): no other OBIX package.
- Used by (OBIX): no other OBIX package.

## Testing

- 1 test file ships in the npm package (`test/`): it is the evidence of the package's contract, published so that its verification can be read — not runtime code (no entry point reaches it).
- Run them with `npm test` (`vitest run`) in the OBIX monorepo, which provides the test tooling (Node's test runner, Vitest, TypeScript).
